description: ABIDE 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：abide 质控汇总；abide 表型/刺激提取；abide 复制整理为 BIDS 目录。

method_refs.label: abide 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries and exclusion lists for ABIDE. Combines fMRIPrep confounds, FreeSurfer recon-all metrics, and ABIDE native QC flags to produce a unified QC report with configurable exclusion criteria。 Inputs: fmriprep_dir: Path to fMRIPrep output directory (directory); freesurfer_dir: Path to FreeSurfer output directory (directory); raw_qc: Path to ABIDE phenotype CSV with QC flags (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: abide 表型/刺激提取
method_refs.role: Extract and merge ABIDE phenotype tables for downstream analysis. Reads ABIDE phenotype CSV files, standardizes diagnosis labels, selects columns, and optionally cross-references with imaging subject lists。 Inputs: phenotype_dir: Directory containing ABIDE phenotype CSV files (directory); phenotype_file: Direct path to ABIDE phenotype CSV file (file); imaging_ids: Path to BIDS participants.tsv or file with imaging subject IDs (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: abide 复制整理为 BIDS 目录
method_refs.role: Reorganize ABIDE raw data into BIDS-style directory structure. Handles FCP/INDI-style subject directories, site extraction, and modality routing for T1w and rs-fMRI。 Inputs: input: Path to ABIDE raw data directory (directory); phenotype: Path to ABIDE phenotype CSV file (file). Registered outputs: results/.

name: abide-skill
